methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This article contributes to answering which management tools promote the realization of

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Empirical study of whether certified energy/environmental management systems (ISO 50001/14001) increase energy-efficiency-measure implementation in large Austrian firms. Its regressions/ANOVA model EEM implementation rate as a function of management style and perceived risk; energy normalisation (baseline/standard year, production volume, heating-degree-days, savings/total-consumption ratio) is an incidental methodological control. No EnPI/EnB measurement model is presented, proposed, evaluated, or characterised (variables/functional form/construction), so EnPI/EnB content is incidental only.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The dataset is cross-sectional in manufacturing, services and construction industries

stage1.notes: Uses baseline/HDD/production normalisation and intensity ratios, but object is management-system effect on EEM uptake, not an EnPI/EnB model. paper_type 'other': large-N econometric firm study.
